summary: Completed Healthcare.gov Interlude reflection ('55 Contractors, Zero Integration Plan'). Evaluated the failure of isolated team plans in the absence of a unified dependency DAG with explicit interface contracts. Proposed an end-to-end architectural mapping and minimal critical path stabilization plan for Day 2 recovery in progress/decomposition/module-02/interlude-healthcare-gov.md.
evidence: Reflected on the architectural failure of Healthcare.gov: 55 contractors with passing unit tests but incompatible interface contracts and no integration plan.
Answered Question 1: Unified DAG exposes interface boundaries, handoff data formats, and critical path bottlenecks invisible to isolated team plans.
Answered Question 2: First Day 2 recovery action is mapping the system, identifying the thinnest enrollment critical path, and instrumenting boundary tracing before triaging bugs.
